processes.process: Appointment request intake, scheduling and reminder queue
processes.automation_boundary: Collect stated appointment preferences, check configured availability and draft or queue reminders; do not triage symptoms, select clinical urgency, recommend care or override staff scheduling policy.
processes.baseline_required: Matched appointment requests, completion and error rate, staff minutes including review/rework, no-show/reminder exceptions, privacy incidents and actual software/operating cost.
processes.metric: Net staff minutes per correctly scheduled, approved appointment; reschedule, duplicate, reminder and privacy-exception rate
processes.falsifier: Reject if wrong-provider/time bookings, unauthorized disclosures, symptom-based triage or review/rework increase, or total effort is not reduced.
processes.human_authority: Practice-designated scheduling staff approve bookings, exceptions and patient communications; licensed clinicians retain all clinical authority.

processes.process: Administrative intake and demographic/document completeness review
processes.automation_boundary: Check required fields, identify duplicates or missing administrative documents and return a request for completion; do not infer diagnoses, clinical history, eligibility or consent.
processes.baseline_required: Matched intake volume, field/document completeness accuracy, staff review and chase time, correction/rework rate, unauthorized-access events and operating cost.
processes.metric: Net staff minutes per accepted complete intake; missing-field, duplicate, correction and privacy-exception rate
processes.falsifier: Reject if incomplete or incorrect records pass acceptance, sensitive information is exposed, or review/chase/rework effort is not lower.
processes.human_authority: Authorized practice staff review identity, consent and administrative completeness; clinicians determine whether information is clinically sufficient.

processes.process: Referral and payer authorization-status queue coordination
processes.automation_boundary: Track supplied referral and authorization statuses, dates and missing administrative artifacts; draft staff follow-up and escalate exceptions. Do not determine medical necessity, coverage, coding, eligibility or approval.
processes.baseline_required: Matched referrals, status freshness and accuracy, staff minutes including payer follow-up/rework, aged exceptions, privacy incidents and operating cost.
processes.metric: Net staff minutes per accurately updated authorization-status item; stale, duplicate, wrong-patient and unresolved-exception rate
processes.falsifier: Reject if stale or wrong-patient statuses drive action, medical-necessity/coverage judgments are automated, or exception and review effort does not fall.
processes.human_authority: Practice authorization staff and payer-designated contacts control submissions and decisions; clinicians retain medical-necessity authority.

processes.process: Approved administrative follow-up and records-request routing
processes.automation_boundary: Draft status, scheduling or records-request messages from current queue state, route for approval and log delivery; do not provide clinical advice, results interpretation or treatment guidance.
processes.baseline_required: Matched message/request volume, correct-recipient rate, human review/rework and retry minutes, duplicate-send/privacy exceptions and operating cost.
processes.metric: Net staff minutes per accurate approved request; response, duplicate, wrong-recipient and privacy-exception rate
processes.falsifier: Reject if a message contains clinical advice, stale or wrong-patient information is sent, duplicate retries occur, or review/rework removes effort reduction.
processes.human_authority: Authorized practice staff approve recipient, content and send; clinicians own any clinical response or interpretation.
